title: Captions
summary: Seven caption styles in the editorial look, playing over the sample clip with its real word timings: a small sentence-case serif on a tight box in the footage's own colours (aubergine, paper, wine), the spoken word in the accent, emphasised words in italic. Words rise from behind the baseline or clear from a soft fade; nothing bounces.
usage: In a storyboard: {"captions": "column"}. column is the theme default and reads on any footage; column-paper for dark backdrops, column-wine as an accent, rise for the masked word-by-word reveal, one-word for a stretch read word by word, underline on paper cards, small-caps under a busy graphic. Words in "emphasis" are italic; level 2 stands alone. Styles: library/themes/editorial/captions/styles.js.
